_meta.description: Empirically-fitted MC input distributions for pymodel.py monte_carlo(). Loaded at runtime; missing file falls back to hardcoded judgment values with stderr warning.
_meta.correlation_matrix_note: 5x5 Gaussian copula (judgment): rg/eg +0.3, rg/vac -0.5, ins/cap +0.3, all others 0. Adjust here to re-run sensitivity.

rent_growth.description: BLS CPI Rent of primary residence, South region (via FRED). Annual YoY growth from monthly index, last 25 years.
rent_growth.note: South CPI rent includes 2021-2023 surge (8-9%). P50 3.2% exceeds old 2% assumption; P90 4.7% vs old 3%. Both shifted up materially.

expense_growth.description: BLS CPI All Items, South region (via FRED). Annual YoY growth from monthly index, last 25 years. LA insurance shocks ride on top as separate insurance_mult factor.
expense_growth.note: P50 2.1% close to old 2.5% assumption. P10 near zero (post-GFC deflation). P90 4.1% slightly above old 4%. LA insurance shock is modeled separately via insurance_mult.

vacancy.description: Census Housing Vacancy Survey rental vacancy rate, South region (via FRED). Quarterly levels 2001-present, expressed as decimal.
vacancy.note: South rental vacancy historically higher than the 7% Stoa benchmark. P50 8.2% vs old 7%. Tertiary market deals should consider adding 1-2pts above regional baseline.

insurance_mult.description: Multiplier applied to base insurance input. No clean public series for LA homeowner/multifamily insurance. Widened significantly from national norm to reflect LA crisis regime.
insurance_mult.note: judgment - LA crisis regime; replace with LDI filing data later. Triangular(0.85, 1.0, 1.8). P90 uses ~1.6 from triangular CDF.

exit_cap_spread.description: Spread added to going-in cap rate at exit. No cap rate transaction series available for LA tertiary markets (non-disclosure state).
exit_cap_spread.note: judgment - calibration log has no cap data (LA non-disclosure). Triangular(-25bps, +50bps, +150bps). P90 ~130bps from triangular CDF.
